headline: Iran: "U.S. Must Compensate for War Damage Before Hormuz Reopens"... Presents 6 Demands
summary: Iran's Supreme National Security Council chairman said Hormuz would reopen only if the US withdraws from Iranian airspace, pays war-damage compensation and lifts sanctions.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key transit route for Gulf oil and LNG, so any closure or uncertainty over its reopening affects global energy supply.
why_moved: Iran has tied reopening the Strait of Hormuz to US compensation and sanctions relief, prolonging uncertainty over Gulf shipping.
